item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed misconduct handling capacity at the Department of Local Government and Regional Development.
item.support: This review was conducted with the support of the Department of Local Government and Regional Development

item.text: It examined the department's investigations, complaint handling, records and relationship with councils and the Commission.
item.support: The Department has a methodical and comprehensive complaints handling system for complaints received from local governments

item.text: The Commission found investigations generally timely, but identified fragmented complaint information and limits on the department's ability to prevent misconduct.
item.support: the Department remains uninformed about most of the matters received

item.text: Its five recommendations covered investigative authority, an interagency agreement, records, disciplinary arrangements, monthly information sharing and checks on misconduct reporting.
item.support: At the conclusion of this report, the Commission makes the following five recommendations

item.quote: This review found that, in most cases, the Department investigates matters of misconduct in a timely fashion.
